about.title: About
about.body: I’ve been creating, dreaming up and organising magical weddings for a long time, always behind the scenes… until now. If you’ve been around here for a while, you may have seen me in a few photos, especially from my own wedding (because yes, I also lived my own fairy tale!). I’m Anna, a naturally creative soul, in love with details and the one steering the ship at The Perfect Match. My story with weddings started many years ago, long before I did this professionally. Since then, I’ve had the privilege of accompanying wonderful couples on one of the most special days of their lives, feeling up close the excitement, nerves and magic surrounding every “I do”. This whole journey has taught me that a wedding is so much more than an event: it is the most authentic expression of a love story. That’s why I approach every project as something unique, infusing it with sensitivity, creativity and that personal touch that makes it unforgettable. That’s how The Perfect Match was born: a space where dreams take shape, details tell stories and every moment becomes an everlasting memory. If you’re here, you probably also believe in the magic of small things. So, shall we create your perfect story together? ✨
about.imageAlt: Photo of the team smiling together in the studio

planning.title: Wedding Planning
planning.description: A complete, seamless and exciting journey. Clear timelines, vendors that truly fit your vision, thoughtful decision-making, and an invisible organization that allows you to reach the aisle without dark circles… and with the energy to celebrate in style.

artDirection.title: Wedding Concept & Art Direction
artDirection.description: A service designed for couples seeking a strong concept and a cohesive narrative that truly stands out. Storytelling, moodboards, color palette, style, artistic references and creative direction. The visual and emotional heart of your big day begins here, with me. The result? An aesthetic experience that speaks about you without needing words.

production.title: Production
production.description: Every detail in its place, every moment flawless. Setup, logistics and vendor coordination so everything aligns, shines, and leaves you only with the joy of experiencing the magic.

coordination.title: Coordination
coordination.description: On the big day, the magic lies in the invisible details: synchronized vendors, well-timed moments, unforeseen issues resolved before they even arise, and an energy that holds everything together.

Destination Weddings.title: Destination Weddings
Destination Weddings.description: Planning, logistics and design for weddings in special locations—crafted so every couple feels at home, even far away. Coordination with local vendors, tailored planning and a creative perspective that turns every corner into part of your story. A wedding that is not only celebrated, but lived and remembered as a unique journey.

Wedding Honeymoon.title: Wedding Honeymoon
Wedding Honeymoon.description: A service that accompanies you beyond the wedding day, designing and coordinating your honeymoon so it is just as unique and memorable as the celebration itself. The goal? To turn it into an extension of your wedding day—an emotional, magical journey filled with unforgettable memories.
